claims.text: Reviewers widely report the product effectively prevents chafing and rashes during beach and water activities, often with a single application lasting all day.
Many reviewers specifically praise it for solving chafing in children, including sons who previously suffered rashes from sand, swimsuits, and boogie boards.
Several reviewers say it outperforms other anti-chafe products and swimwear they had tried before.
Reviewers report it works well for inner-thigh chafing and stays effective even after swimming or in humid conditions.
A few reviewers note it can be used for chafing from non-beach causes as well, such as damp skin after a shower.
